purpose: A compact trend beside a number, with no axes or gridlines: a line over a soft area with a dot on the last point, showing where the value came from.

notFor.case: A full chart with axes and gridlines: use a charting layer.
One reading against a known range.
A metric's change inside a table.

Variant=default.visual: Line and dot in Chart/series-1/solid over a Chart/series-1/soft area.

Variant=secondary.visual: Line and dot in Content/secondary over a Surface/muted area.

Variant=success.visual: Line and dot in Status/success/surface-solid over a Status/success/surface area.

Variant=critical.visual: Line and dot in Status/critical/surface-solid over a Status/critical/surface area.

a11y.reducedMotion: Instant: no line draw on mount (use-reveal) and no cross-fade of new data (use-color).
notes: A required aria-label states the trend ("Daily active users, up 7.2 % this week"); the drawing is hidden from assistive tech.

openQuestions: The contract has no Figma set (codeOnly, finding DOC-001 Sparkline). Is a Figma set planned, or is code the owner here?
Size sm draws the line at a literal 1.5 hairline, not a stroke role. Is a stroke role missing?
